verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs claim seamless integration with Hugging Face models and support for 200+ model architectures on HuggingFace. They describe loading Hugging Face Model Hub models, including custom ones via `--trust-remote-code`, and a Transformers modeling backend for broader coverage. A community comment corroborates the 'huge model library' as a key strength. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the automatic download flow (e.g., serving directly by HF repo ID, caching/auth for gated models), independent hands-on corroboration of pulling models from the Hub.
